title: M3-Former: Multimodal Transformer with Mixture-of-Experts for Long-Term Vessel Trajectory Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.10559v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: To address the challenges of behavioral multimodality, limited semantic utilization, and long-term error accumulation in vessel trajectory prediction, this paper proposes M3-Former, a multimodal trajectory prediction framework enhanced by large language models (LLMs). The proposed framework incorporates vessel static attributes and navigational intent as semantic priors for long-term trajectory modeling. Specifically, a unified multimodal representation space is constructed, in which static semantic information is encoded by a pre-trained LLM and aligned with dynamic trajectory features through self-attention. To jointly capture global route planning and local motion variations, a dual-granularity Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture is introduced, where sequence-level experts model global navigation trends and token-level experts refine fine-grained maneuvering behaviors. In addition, a Steering-Weighted Cross-Entropy loss is designed

translated_title: M3-Former：基于混合专家的多模态Transformer用于长期船舶轨迹预测
translated_abstract: 为解决船舶轨迹预测中行为多模态性、语义信息利用有限以及长期预测误差累积等挑战，本文提出了M3-Former，一种由大语言模型（LLM）增强的多模态轨迹预测框架。该框架将船舶静态属性和航行意图作为长期轨迹建模的语义先验。具体而言，框架构建了一个统一的多模态表示空间，其中静态语义信息由预训练的LLM进行编码，并通过自注意力机制与动态轨迹特征对齐。为了联合捕获全局航线规划与局部运动变化，该框架引入了双粒度混合专家架构，其中序列级专家用于建模全局导航趋势，词元级专家用于细化细粒度的船舶操纵行为。此外，本文还设计了一种转向加权交叉熵损失。
tldr: 提出M3-Former框架，利用大语言模型编码船舶静态语义先验，并通过双粒度混合专家架构联合建模全局航线规划与细粒度操纵行为，以解决长期船舶轨迹预测中的行为多模态、语义利用有限和误差累积问题。
en_tdlr: M3-Former is an LLM-enhanced multimodal framework that encodes vessel static semantic priors and employs a dual-granularity Mixture-of-Experts architecture to jointly capture global route planning and fine-grained maneuvering behaviors for long-term vessel trajectory prediction.
